Fixed in pkix-chain/src/lib.rs. Both .ok_or arms in enforce_timestamping_eku_critical_and_sole carried the byte-identical string 'TSA certificate has no ExtendedKeyUsage extension'; they now share one arm, with extensions() mapped through .map_or(&[][..], ..) so a certificate with no extension block is treated as having an empty one. Provably the same behaviour: None previously produced that error directly, and now yields an empty slice whose find() misses and produces the same error.

Found a second instance of the same pattern in the same function that neither this bead nor its twin mentioned: the match on eku.0 had [_] and _ arms carrying identical strings too. Collapsed to one _ arm, which is equivalent because everything the guarded timeStamping arm rejects fails for that single reason.

Independently filed as PKIX-q9hv.30 by the other pkix-chain review pass; closed alongside. Two reviewers finding the same thing is corroboration, so both are recorded as real rather than one dismissed as noise.

199 pkix-chain tests green; verify_time_stamper's extra_eku and wrong_eku cases exercise the collapsed match arms.
